name: sprites exist for what is on the canvas, and for nothing else

steps.note: yard is 12x9 = 576x432 world units; the canvas at the default zoom is
320x180 of that, so most of the map is off screen at any moment.
Paused first: the canvas is small and a wanderer would leave it between steps.
one corner: the near human is drawn and the far one is not
and the other corner, the other way round - the same two units, one sprite
a selected unit stays selected when it is culled: Selected is a Uid and
picking goes through the simulation's occupancy grid, not through sprites.
the yard stands in the wasteland, so nothing clamps the camera: looking at (9,6) puts it on world (456, 312)
and the unit there at the middle of the canvas, (160, 90) - left of the log panel and
below the top one, both of which absorb clicks.

steps.shot: still selected from across the map

steps.note: what a hand holds is drawn beside its carrier rather than as a child of it,
so it has to be culled by the same rule or it floats where nobody is
zooming out makes the canvas bigger, so it shows more world and draws more:
at zoom 1 the whole 576x432 yard is inside a 1280x720 canvas and both are drawn, and the wasteland round it fills the rest
and leaving takes every sprite away, the ones parked for reuse included
